reason: The permitted external lem-stage1-quotient-manifold-package states only that the set quotient breve-calU=calU_e/U(1) is a smooth manifold; it does not assert that the canonical projection pi:calU_e->breve-calU is smooth or a submersion, nor that ker(Dpi_J)=iR*J. The left-inversion external supplies a smooth descended breve-sigma but does not supply differentiability of pi. Hence the step's differentiation of pi o sigma=breve-sigma o pi and the identification T_[J]breve-calU congruent T_JcalU_e/(iR*J) use an unstated quotient-submersion theorem/property not present in node 1.2.1 or the allowed external contracts. Without that missing input, the induced-quotient derivative conclusion does not follow.
